name: Text-to-Image Meta-evaluation Benchmark
description: A meta-evaluation benchmark and dataset for assessing automatic evaluation metrics for text-to-image generation via task decomposition and distilled training.
evaluation_method: human_eval combined with correlation analysis (e.g., Spearman/Kendall correlation between automatic metrics and human judgments)
general_score_metric: Spearman correlation to human judgments (metric–human correlation)
reputation: A recent ACL-2025 research benchmark for meta-evaluating T2I automatic metrics that is gaining attention among researchers developing and validating evaluation metrics.
notes: Meta-evaluation benchmark (evaluates metrics, not generators). Relies on human annotations and distilled training; may be relatively small/curated and not directly indicative of generator quality. Potential portability limits across domains and risk of metric overfitting.
